name: UCSD For Hemophilia 2023

venue.name: UC San Diego
venue.address: Price Center, UCSD, 9500 Gilman Dr, La Jolla, CA 92093

information: All profits from this competition will be donated to the [Hemophilia Foundation of Nothern California (HFNC)](https://www.hemofoundation.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0kyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--66792e7029ce097ec547af3a169e14f17ae6296a/For%20All%20Bleeding%20Disorders%20-%20Edited.png) This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [New Competitors tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDForHemophilia2023#27597-new-competitors). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZzB5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c648f1c37642837bd6ec7ced2a03e220352f5fbb/wcc-banner.png) **When registering, please put the actual amount of guests that will come with you. Nobody will be denied entry. We just need the expected attendance to be as accurate as possible.**
